meta.question: on Aircraft (final, seeds 1-3, K=29), do the patches MaskedKD drops from e25 to final rank higher in the teacher's own attention rollout than the patches it takes in, and does that go with signal loss?
meta.method: per image mean teacher-rollout rank of dropped minus entered patches (e25 -> final top-29 kept sets); seed-mean per image; mean with image bootstrap; Spearman with the change of KL(full || masked teacher)
meta.paper: Son et al. ECCV 2024 (MaskedKD); Abnar & Zuidema ACL 2020 (attention rollout); Hinton et al. 2015; Maji et al. 2013 (FGVC-Aircraft)
